successCriterion: ROLE_CAPPAR has zero mixed scalar classes and all exact controls pass; fresh non-affine significance additionally requires DEGREE1 contradictions > 0.
nextIfFreshNonAffineSuccess: Integrate the fresh qualification and proceed to scalar decoder discovery directly in the compressed role-capacity/ZOE coordinate.

nextIfFail: Freeze the minimum collision and compare ROLE_CAP3 and ROLE_CAP_EXACT before any new feature is introduced.
interpretationGuards: Passing is finite Q-V evidence only.
